sources.entry: Court Rules - Free reference for U.S. federal court rules, local rules, judge standing orders, and court holidays, with a deadline calculator and an MCP server. #freemium

summary.name: CourtRules.app
summary.one_liner: A free, searchable reference of U.S. federal and state court rules, judge standing orders and local rules, plus court holiday calendars, deadline calculators and privacy enforcement action data.
keywords: how to check judge rules before filing
use_cases: Checking a judge's page limits and formatting rules before filing
Finding courtesy copy or pre-motion letter requirements
Calculating court days and business days to a filing deadline
Looking up federal and state court holiday closures
Researching privacy fines and settlements by agency
Connecting court rule data to AI assistants via MCP
summary.what_it_does: The site collects standing orders, individual practices and local rules published by federal and state judges and makes them searchable by court, judge or topic, such as page limits, courtesy copies, sealing and e-filing. Each rule links to the court's source document. It offers deadline calculators for court days and federal deadlines, plus closure calendars for federal and state courts. It also lists structured privacy enforcement records from the FTC, HHS (HIPAA) and state attorneys general, with fine amounts, violation types and links to official sources. A REST API and an MCP server expose the same data to other tools.
notable: Every rule links to the court's own source document, with page and section tracing
Deadline calculators and court holiday calendars for federal and state courts
Privacy enforcement action database covering FTC, HHS OCR and state AGs
MCP server works with Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf and Codex CLI
caveats: Browsing rules is free and needs no sign-up, but API and MCP access requires an account and API key
Not legal advice; users are told to confirm with the court's source
Standing order and rule currency depends on periodic re-verification against court websites
